# marine_ais

- **Layer**: core
- **Packages**: `marine_ais_msgs`, `marine_ais_tools`
- **Language**: C++/Python (msgs C++, tools Python)
- **Governance**: No `.agents/README.md`

## Key Dependencies
- geographic_msgs, nmea_msgs, sensor_msgs, python3-serial, tf_transformations

## Description
AIS (Automatic Identification System) message types and tools. Parses AIS data from serial receivers and publishes vessel tracks.
